Mod.name: Mahoraga: Adapt to Anything
Mod.description: Mahoraga, the Eight-Handled Wheel, waits in a temple arena carved into the great wall at the far east of the world (cross the desert eastwards). Every parallel world has its own, tougher Mahoraga. He has 8000 health and hits hard (his weakest hit deals 200). He adapts to anything, even drowning: take enough of one kind of damage and his wheel turns and he becomes immune to it. Every adaptation heals him to full and doubles his health and all his damage. Fire takes longer to adapt to. His Sword of Extermination slashes cut through everything. The wheel teaches him new techniques: Giant Slash (melee), Giant Napalm (fire), Giant Nuke (explosions), Electrocute Giant Punch (electricity), Holy Shower (holy) and World Cutting Slash (slicing: about 3 seconds of huge white cuts across the area). Defeat him for two perks. Adapt to Anything: each kind of harm you keep taking, drowning included, hurts you 50% less, then 75% less, and at the third step you are fully immune to it; every new kind of harm you adapt to also gives you +50% max health and +50% damage, compounding. Summon Mahoraga: press your summon key (default G, set it in Options > Mod settings) to call your own Mahoraga and again to dismiss him; he fights everything but you (his explosions can't hurt you), takes every adaptation you have with the same doubling and the techniques they unlock. Fan-made, inspired by Jujutsu Kaisen by Gege Akutami.
